what: Stage-2 mirror parity break: a trail/stop move reaches only the LINKED (real-money) leg; the mirror sibling keeps its entry-time stop at the venue. MEASURED 2026-11-24: pkg-b7456c45491e44c2 (ml_entry ADAUSDT long): bybit_2 #8459 SL 0.14421 vs bybit_portfolio #8460 SL 0.14299 (LTR mechanics flag 00:09Z; EXIT-PATH GAP 'divergent' 00:57Z, src/runtime/package_leg_coverage.py). Real money is protected as declared; the mirror's P&L diverges from live, and the mirror's net-of-cost window is the Stage-2 DEMOTION signal (OPERATING-PLAN s.2), so this corrupts the demotion input. Fix: propagate every stop/TP amend to all sibling legs of the package (the same apply path live_review_apply / the trail uses), or re-sync siblings on each monitor pass; add a parity test. Order-path change = Tier 2. MEASURED 2026-11-24T04:01Z (second symptom, same root): the live-review CLOSE LR-20261124T0307Z applied to bybit_2 at 03:12Z did NOT close the bybit_portfolio mirror -- LTR packet LR-20261124T0401Z shows bybit_portfolio position True, SL 0.143 / TP 0.1568.
